blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In recent years, digital agents [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] have expanded from digital environments to the physical world. Driven by continued progress in large vision-language models, digital agents can now interpret complex instructions, plan long-horizon tasks, invoke external tools, and adjust their behavior according to feedback. Their success in digital interaction scenarios points to their potential to serve as a general-purpose “brain” in the real world. In Physical AI, however, language and visual reasoning alone cannot support reliable real-world interaction: an agent should translate high-level semantic goals into physical behaviors aligned with the real-world environments while perceiving environmental changes, evaluating the effects of its actions, and revising subsequent decisions throughout execution.
blocks.zh: 近年来,数字代理[1,2,3,4]已经从数字环境扩展到了物理世界. 在大型视觉语言模型的持续进步的推动下,数字代理现在可以解释复杂的指令,规划长视距任务,引用外部工具,并根据反馈调整其行为. 它们在数字互动设想中的成功表明,他们有可能成为现实世界的通用“人才”。 然而,在"物理AI"中,语言和视觉推理本身不能支持可靠的现实世界互动:一个代理人应该将高层次的语义目标转化为与现实世界环境相适应的物理行为,同时能感知环境的变化,评价其行动的影响,并在整个执行过程中修订后续的决定.

blocks.en:
These observations lead us to argue that an embodied agent operating in the physical world requires at least two synergistic core capabilities. The first is embodied cognition: the ability to perceive, understand, and reason about physical environments, with the key breakthroughs being strengthened geometric perception of physical elements and space, modeling of temporal action sequences, and modeling of execution feedback, which together establish native cognition of the real physical world.
The second is agent capability: building on the enhanced spatial, temporal, and dynamics awareness, the agent combines long-horizon autonomous planning, skill and tool invocation, and reflection with failure attribution to drive its embodied platform through operations in real physical scenes, achieving a closed loop from perception and planning to action execution, feedback, and correction. An agent equipped with both capabilities could turn an open-ended goal into an executable process spanning multiple steps and skills, adapt its policy when the environment changes or execution fails, and thereby be deployed in real-world industries, robotics, and intelligent manufacturing.
blocks.zh:
这些观察使我们认为,在物理世界中运作的一种体现性剂至少需要两种协同核心能力。 第一种是体现认知能力:对物理环境的感知、理解和理性的能力,关键突破是加强了对物理要素和空间的几何感知,对时间动作序列进行了模型化,对执行反馈进行了模型化,共同建立了对真实物理世界的本土认知.
第二是代理能力:在增强空间、时间和动态意识的基础上,代理将长视线的自主规划、技能和工具引用以及反思与失败归属结合起来,通过实际物理场景中的操作驱动其体现的平台,实现从感知和规划到行动执行、反馈和纠正的闭环。 具备两种能力的代理人可以将一个无限制的目标变成一个可执行的过程,涵盖多个步骤和技能,在环境变化或执行失败时调整其政策,从而被部署在现实世界的工业、机器人和智能制造中。

blocks.en:
Guided by this capability framework, this paper proposes MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a foundation model for physical AI that unifies embodied cognition and agent capabilities. To this end, we
construct multi-dimensional training data covering both capability domains and design a unified joint training pipeline, enabling the model to learn embodied cognition and agent capabilities
within a single framework. Unlike existing pipelines that simply cascade a planner and executors [ 5 ] , ME-VLM adopts a unified modeling approach in which embodied cognition and agentic decisions
mutually constrain each other: perception and understanding of the real physical environment ground task planning and skill selection, while the physical states observed during execution in turn steer the model’s attention toward the relevant objects and target regions and inform its subsequent decisions.
blocks.zh:
以这一能力框架为指导,本文提出了MachEmbody-VLM(ME-VLM),这是体能AI的基础模型,统一了所体现认知和代理能力. 为此,我们
构建涵盖能力领域的多维培训数据并设计统一的联合培训管道,使该模式能够学习体现的认知能力和代理能力
在一个单一框架内。 与仅将计划和执行者级联[5]的现有管道不同,ME-VLM采用了一种统一的建模方法,其中体现了认知和代理决定。
相互制约:对实际物理环境的认知和理解:地面任务规划和技能选择,而在执行过程中观察到的物理状态反过来将模型的注意力引向相关对象和目标区域,并指导其随后的决定。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , ME-VLM achieves competitive performance on both embodied benchmarks and agent benchmarks. Beyond these settings, ME-VLM can be adapted to autonomous driving and embodied navigation, attaining competitive results on driving and navigation benchmarks as well, indicating that the learned embodied capabilities have potential for transfer across tasks.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,ME-VLM在包含的基准和代理基准上都取得了竞争性的业绩。 除了这些环境之外,ME-VLM还可以适应自主驾驶和所体现导航,在驾驶和导航基准方面也取得竞争结果,表明所学到的所体现能力具有跨任务转移的潜力。

blocks.en: Considering the stringent requirements on inference latency, power consumption, and compute in real-world deployments, we further co-optimize ME-VLM for edge-side chips. On the algorithmic side, we compress non-essential inference tokens, reduce redundant intermediate reasoning, and lower the frequency of model invocations during task execution, thereby reducing the agent’s inference overhead. On the system side, quantized deployment, operator adaptation, and hardware–software co-optimization improve on-device execution efficiency. Together, these optimizations enable ME-VLM to perform low-latency local inference under limited compute resources, supporting the real-time execution loop of embodied systems.
blocks.zh: 考虑到在现实世界部署中对推论延迟、耗能和计算的严格要求,我们进一步合作优化边缘侧芯片的ME-VLM。 在算法方面,我们压缩非必要的推论符,减少冗余的中间推理,并降低任务执行过程中模型引用的频率,从而减少代理推论的间接. 在系统方面,量化部署、操作员适应和硬件软件协同优化提高了设备执行效率。 这些优化共同使ME-VLM能够在有限的计算资源下进行低纬度局部推论,支持所包含系统的实时执行循环.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • An embodied VLM with enhanced physical cognition. Building on strengthened physical cognition, ME-VLM realizes a complete closed loop spanning user intent understanding, environment perception, and task planning, through to skill invocation, action execution, and outcome verification and correction. • Unified training data and a joint training pipeline. We construct training data covering physical understanding, task planning, skill invocation, execution-process understanding, and failure correction, as well as a unified training pipeline through which the model learns, within a single framework, capabilities spanning perception, planning with decision-making, and execution with verification. • Validation of cross-task generalization. We show that ME-VLM can be transferred to autonomous driving and embodied robotic tasks, achieving competitive performance in both. • Co-optimization for edge deployment. We perform token compression, quantization, and hardware-software co-optimization targeting edge-side chips, reducing inference latency and computational cost while improving the feasibility of deploying the model in real embodied systems.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 具有增强物理认知的 VLM 内含. 在加强实际认知的基础上,ME-VLM实现了一个完全封闭的循环,涵盖用户的意向理解、环境感知和任务规划,直至技能引用、行动执行以及结果核实和纠正。 • 统一培训数据和联合培训管道。 我们构建培训数据,涵盖实际理解、任务规划、技能引用、执行过程理解和故障校正,以及统一的培训管道,通过这一管道,模型在一个框架内学习跨越认知的能力、决策规划以及核查执行。 • 鉴定跨任务概况。 我们显示,ME-VLM可以被转移到自主驱动和体现机器人任务,在两者中都实现有竞争力的性能. 二. 支助 配合优化边缘部署. 我们以边缘侧芯片为目标,进行象征性压缩、量化和硬件软件协同优化,减少推论延迟和计算成本,同时提高将该模型部署在真正体现的系统中的可行性。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Digital Agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 数字代理

blocks.en:
The Qwen series [ 1 ] have recently continuously strengthened vision–language alignment, long-context processing, and tool invocation. The GLM-5 series [ 3 ] unify agent, reasoning, and coding capabilities within a single Mixture-of-Experts architecture, and through its asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure and Agent RL algorithms substantially improves the model’s performance in long-horizon interaction, tool invocation, and self-correction. Kimi K3 [ 2 ] , built on an MoE architecture with a million-token context window, applies reinforcement learning simultaneously across long-horizon programming, general-purpose agents, and multimodal reasoning, training the model to complete a full agentic loop over interaction trajectories spanning hundreds to thousands of tool calls.
However, the capabilities of these digital agent models are rooted in the interaction paradigm of the digital world: their tool invocation, reasoning chains, and context management are all oriented toward digital-space tasks such as text, code, and web pages, and lack systematic modeling of spatial structure perception in the physical world, semantic understanding of robot actions, and monitoring of execution states. This limitation is precisely complementary to embodied-domain models, and it is the core motivation for this paper’s proposal to unify the two classes of capabilities.
blocks.zh:
Quen系列[1]最近不断强化视觉-语言相接,长文本处理和工具引用. GLM-5系列[3]在单一的Mixture-of-Experts架构内统一了代理,推理和编码能力,并通过其同步的强化学习基础设施和Agent RL算法,大大地改善了模型在长距离相互作用,工具引用和自修正方面的性能. Kimi K3 [2] 以一个具有百万托肯上下文窗口的MOE架构为基础,在长视编程,通用代理和多模式推理中同时应用强化学习,训练模型完成一个跨越上百至上千个工具调用的互动轨迹的全代理循环.
然而,这些数字代理模型的能力根植于数字世界的互动范式:其工具引用,推理链和上下文管理都面向文本,代码和网页等数字空间任务,缺乏物理世界空间结构感知的系统模型,对机器人动作的语义理解,以及执行状态的监测. 这一限制恰恰是对内在领域模式的补充,也是本文件关于统一两类能力的建议的核心动机。

blocks.en: 2.2  Embodied VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 体能活性半径

blocks.en:
With the rapid evolution of vision-language models, the research community has begun exploring the transfer of general agent capabilities to the domain of physical AI, aiming to build embodied specialist models with strong cognitive abilities in the physical world. RynnBrain 1.1 [ 6 ] introduces contact-point prediction and native 3D spatial perception, along with a unified cross-embodiment action space, aligning model outputs more closely with the demands of robotic manipulation. Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 [ 7 ] proposes an action-centric three-tier capability taxonomy and achieves high-performance physical-world reasoning across multiple benchmarks. Vesta [ 8 ] presents a general embodied reasoning model that unifies localization, navigation, embodied question answering, and long-horizon planning within a single foundation model, supported by a multimodal memory mechanism for cross-step context management. MiMo-Embodied [ 9 ] integrates autonomous driving and embodied AI into a single VLM, and demonstrates positive transfer and mutual reinforcement between the two physical-world domains through multi-stage learning, revealing the potential of cross-embodiment foundation models.
While prior works advance embodied cognition, they offer limited support for multi-turn agent reasoning, skill invocation under open-ended instructions, execution-state monitoring, error diagnosis, and long-horizon planning. To bridge this gap, we jointly train embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities as mutually reinforcing objectives within a single unified model.
blocks.zh:
随着视觉语言模型的快速演变,研究界开始探索将一般剂能转移到物理AI领域,目的是在物理世界建立具有强大认知能力的已体现的专家模型. RynnBrain 1.1 [6]引入了接触点预测和本土3D空间感知,同时引入了统一的交叉化活性空间,使模型输出更紧密地配合了机器人操纵的需求. Hy-Emfective-VLM-1.0 [7]提出以行动为中心的三级能力分类法,并实现跨越多个基准的高性能物理-世界推理. Vesta [8] 提出了一种一般的已体现的推理模型,该模型统一了本地化,通航,包含回答问题,并在单一的基础模型中进行长视距规划,辅以跨步骤上下文管理的多模式内存机制. MiMo-Embody [9] 将自主驱动和体现AI整合为一个单一的VLM,并通过多阶段学习表现出两个物理-世界域之间的正向转移和相得益彰,揭示出跨表现基础模型的潜力.
虽然前作的推进体现了认知,但它们为多回合代理推理、在无限制指令下技能引用、执行状态监测、错误诊断和长视距规划提供了有限的支持。 为了弥补这一差距,我们共同培训了体现的认知能力和多式联运代理能力,将其作为单一统一模式中相辅相成的目标。

blocks.en: 3  Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3个 数据构建

blocks.en: Digital agents accumulate task-solving experience in the digital world through closed-loop interaction with multimodal context, tools, and skills. Interaction tasks in the physical world, however, demand that these capabilities be grounded in partially observable physical states, spatial constraints, object affordances, and real-world feedback. To this end, our data construction pipeline adopts a unified task-processing paradigm that bridges embodied cognition and interactive capability, building upon digital-world semantic understanding to endow the model with the ability to perceive and understand the real physical world and to autonomously execute physical tasks.
blocks.zh: 数字代理商通过与多模式背景、工具和技能的闭路互动,积累了数字世界的任务解决经验。 然而,物理世界中的相互作用任务要求将这些能力建立在部分可观测的物理状态、空间限制、物体承受能力和现实世界反馈的基础上。 为此,我们的数据建设管道采用统一的任务处理模式,在数字世界语义理解的基础上,搭起体现认知和互动能力的桥梁,使模型具有感知和理解实际世界的能力,并能自主地执行实际任务。

blocks.en: 3.1  Capability Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.1 能力分类

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Capability Transfer Rationale
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 能力转移理由

blocks.en: An embodied agent is an extension and dimensional uplift of the digital agent’s capabilities, not a capability system built from scratch. Both belong to the same family of agent models: they share a common technical foundation and possess four core underlying capabilities, which also constitute the prerequisites for a digital agent to evolve into an embodied agent: perception of environment, long-horizon task planning, action execution, and diagnosis of real-environment feedback with action correction. Building on this common foundation, the two differ across several dimensions, including scenario boundary, cognitive paradigm, governing rules, and task loop.
blocks.zh: 一个内含的代理是数字代理能力的延伸和维度提升,而不是从零开始建立的能力系统. 两者都属于同一系列的代理模型:它们具有共同的技术基础并拥有四个核心基础能力,这也构成了数字代理人演化成一个被体现的代理的前提条件:环境感知,长视距任务规划,行动执行,以及真实环境反馈的诊断与行动修正. 在这个共同的基础上,两者在几个方面有所不同,包括情景边界、认知范式、管理规则和任务循环。

blocks.en: In terms of operating scenarios, digital agents are confined to two-dimensional, deterministic virtual spaces without physical structure or dynamics, whereas embodied agents face three-dimensional, uncertain real physical spaces with complex variables such as physical disturbances. At the perception and cognition level, digital agents possess only digital semantic perception, without 3D spatial modeling, temporal dynamics, or mechanical understanding, whereas embodied agents are equipped with comprehensive physical perception spanning spatial geometry and action execution. In terms of governing rules, digital agents follow digital logic and software conventions, whereas embodied agents must strictly obey objective physical laws, adapting their decisions to physical rules such as force balance and motion constraints. At the task-loop level, the digital agent performs an information-processing loop that iterates over data and information, whereas the embodied agent performs a physical-actuation loop that alters the state of the real physical world through hardware execution.
blocks.zh: 就操作情景而言,数字代理局限于二维的,决定性的虚拟空间,没有物理结构或动力,而被体现的代理则面临三维的,不确定的真实物理空间,有物理扰动等复杂的变量. 在感知和认知层面,数字剂只拥有数字语义感知,没有3D空间模型,时间动力学或机械理解,而所体现剂则配备了涵盖空间几何和动作执行的全面物理感知. 在规则方面,数字代理遵循数字逻辑和软件惯例,而所体现代理则必须严格遵守客观的物理法则,使其决定适应武力平衡和运动约束等物理规则. 在任务启动层面,数字代理执行一个信息处理回路,该回路比起数据和信息,而所包含代理则执行一个物理激活回路,通过硬件执行来改变实体世界的状态.

blocks.en: To accomplish the evolution from digital agent to embodied agent, we define a clear transfer boundary. Capabilities belonging to the general problem-solving structure, including multimodal perception, long-horizon task understanding, tool and skill invocation, and reasoning with attribution, which can be effectively transferred from the digital-agent domain to the physical domain [ 10 , 11 ] . Capabilities unique to embodied tasks, including spatial state estimation, reasoning about object affordances, modeling of physical action constraints, prediction of action consequences, and closed-loop feedback from the real world, which require first establishing cognition of the physical world and cannot be substituted by digital-agent experience.
blocks.zh: 为了完成从数字代理到体现代理的演化,我们定义了明确的转移边界. 属于一般解决问题结构的能力,包括多模式感知、长视距任务理解、工具和技能引用以及归属推理,这些能力可以有效地从数字代理域转移到物理域 [10, 11]. 包含的任务独有的能力,包括空间状态估计,物体承受力的推理,物理动作约束的模型化,动作后果的预测,以及来自现实世界的闭路回馈,这需要首先建立对物理世界的认知,不能被数字代理经验所取而代之.

blocks.en: Our ME-VLM is built precisely on this boundary: while inheriting the general problem-solving capabilities endowed by digital agents, it systematically introduces embodied cognition to address the core weakness of digital agents, their lack of understanding of physical changes, thereby converting general task-planning priors into embodied intelligence that can be reliably executed in real physical environments.
blocks.zh: 我们的ME-VLM正是在这个边界上建立的:它继承了由数字代理赋予的一般解决问题的能力,同时系统地引入了体现性的认知,以解决数字代理的核心弱点,即他们对物理变化缺乏了解,从而将一般的任务规划前述转化为可可靠地在实际环境中执行的体现性智能。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the ME-VLM framework. ME-VLM integrates agentic and embodied capabilities through a five-stage loop of perception, reasoning, action, verification, and replanning, bridging digital and physical tasks with support for efficient hardware deployment.
blocks.zh: 图2:ME-VLM框架概述. ME-VLM通过认知、推理、行动、核查和再规划的五阶段循环,整合了代理和体现的能力,将数字和物理任务与支持高效硬件部署联系起来。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Dual-Capability Cooperation
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 双重能力合作

blocks.en: Embodied intelligence systems are not built by simply stacking physical perception and action-execution modules on top of the capabilities of a digital agent. Rather, they require the construction of a bidirectional driving loop in which embodied cognition and embodied agency are tightly coupled. Within this loop, the embodied agent assumes the global-task function, supplying overall task planning, high-level operational goals, long-horizon contextual association, and the basis for decision-making. Embodied cognition assumes the functions of environmental perception and physical execution, outputting physical-scene states, action-execution results, and environmental feedback signals that underpin cognitive iteration, policy correction, and behavior optimization [ 12 , 13 ] . Together, the two form a collaborative paradigm of “cognitive feedforward, physical feedback, dynamic correction, and continuous iteration.” This layered collaboration mechanism aligns with the dual cognitive–motor system logic of the human brain: the prefrontal cortex is responsible for goal setting, long-range planning, and action monitoring and diagnosis, corresponding to agency capability; the sensorimotor cortex is responsible for scene perception, limb regulation, and the grounded execution of actions, corresponding to embodied physical cognition capability. Concretely, cognitive capability and agency capability construct a complete embodied-intelligence closed-loop system through four core collaborative relationships:
blocks.zh: 健全的智能系统不是通过简单地将物理感知和动作执行模块堆放在数字代理的能力上来构建的. 相反,它们需要构建双向驱动循环,其中体现的认知和体现的机构紧密结合。 在这一循环中,体现的代理人承担全球任务职能,提供总体任务规划、高级别业务目标、长期背景联系以及决策基础。 健全的认知承担环境感知和物理执行、输出物理-场景状态、行动-执行结果以及支持认知迭代的环境反馈信号、政策矫正和行为优化[12、13]等功能。 两者共同构成了“认知反馈、物理反馈、动态校正和连续迭代”的合作范例。 这种分层协作机制符合人类大脑的双重认知—运动系统逻辑:前额皮层负责目标设定,远程规划,以及动作监测和诊断,与机能相对应;感官皮层负责场景感知,肢体调节,以及动作的有根据执行,与所体现物理认知能力相对应. 具体地说,认知能力和代理能力通过四个核心合作关系构建了一个完整的内在智能闭路系统:

blocks.en: First, multimodal perception evolves into understanding of physical state. The multimodal perception of an agent remains at the level of recognizing image, text, and interface semantics, with the core objective of parsing digital information. It lacks awareness of the physical attributes. In the bidirectional closed-loop system of an embodied agent, multimodal perception is upgraded from mere semantic-information recognition to element- and space-level perception oriented toward the physical scene. Leveraging cross-modal alignment capability, the model not only recognizes object categories and scene semantics but further perceives object spatial position, geometric structure, relative relationships, and dynamic-change trends, achieving a fine-grained understanding of the global state of the physical scene [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 首先,多式联运观念会演变为对物理状态的理解. 对代理人的多模式感知仍然处于识别图像、文本和界面语义的层面上,其核心目标是分析数字信息。 它缺乏对物理属性的认识。 在一种被体现的代理人的双向闭路系统中,多式联运感知从单纯的语义信息识别提升到面向物理场景的元素和空间层面感知. 利用跨模式对接能力,该模型不仅识别对象类别和场景语义,而且还能进一步感知到对象的空间位置,几何结构,相对关系,以及动态变化趋势,实现对物理场景全球状态的精细理解[6].

blocks.en: Second, long-horizon task understanding constrains embodied global planning. The long-horizon reasoning and global context-modeling capabilities of the agent provide cross-subtask, cross-step overall goal constraints for embodied task planning, so that every decision made during physical execution is subordinated to the global task logic [ 8 , 12 ] . This prevents the localized bias of single-step optimality at the cost of global mismatch, and realizes structured, orderly, long-horizon planning of physical operations.
blocks.zh: 第二,对长期任务的理解限制了体现的全球规划。 该代理商的长期推理和全球环境模型能力为体现的任务规划提供了跨子任务,跨步骤的总体目标限制,因此,在实际执行过程中作出的每一项决定都服从全球任务逻辑[8,12]. 这防止了以全球不匹配为代价的单步优化的局部偏好,并实现了结构化,有序化,长距离的物理操作规划.

blocks.en: Third, tool and skill invocation empowers embodied action execution. The tool and skill capabilities of the agent take on the function of translating semantics from the cognitive to the physical-execution ability, converting high-level task-planning intent into structured semantic instructions recognizable for robot action understanding, trajectory planning, grasping execution, and navigational movement. Here, external tools supplement environmental and external information for physical reasoning, while internal tools encapsulate foundational robotic capabilities such as object detection and grasp planning into standardized semantic-skill interfaces [ 11 , 10 ] . Through the Agentic Loop, the agent orchestrates and invokes these on demand, performing adaptive matching in accordance with task characteristics, observation modality, and action semantics, and thereby achieves modular, compositional execution of complex physical tasks. This constitutes the core bridge through which cognitive intent is grounded as physical action.
blocks.zh: 第三,工具和技能的援引赋予了具体的行动执行权力。 代理人的工具和技能能力承担了将语义从认知转化为物理执行能力的功能,将高级任务规划意图转化为结构化的语义指令可识别,用于机器人动作理解,轨迹规划,把握执行,和导航运动. 在这里,外部工具对物理推理的环境和外部信息起到补充作用,而内部工具则囊括了基础机器人能力,如物体检测和把握规划入标准化的语义-技能界面[11,10]. 通过Agentic Loop,代理根据需求来协调和引用这些功能,按照任务特征,观测模式,动作语义进行适应性匹配,从而实现复杂物理任务的模块化,组成性执行. 这构成了认知意图作为实际行动的基础的核心桥梁。

blocks.en: Fourth, reasoning and attribution capability support verification and error recovery. The causal reasoning and task attribution of the agent provide the core decision basis for anomaly checking, error correction, and fault recovery in the embodied system. Embodied cognition can only perceive execution anomalies and state deviations. It cannot distinguish whether the root cause of an error originates from perception noise, planning bias, or environmental disturbance. The embodied-agent capability can conduct a global postmortem in combination with task instructions, the trajectory of environmental state evolution, and historical interaction experience, pinpoint the cause of an error, and generate a corrective strategy [ 14 , 10 ] . The stronger the attribution and reasoning capability, the higher the system’s learning efficiency from failure samples, and the higher the upper bound of the self-evolutionary iteration of physical AI.
blocks.zh: 第四,推理和归属能力支持核实和找回错误。 代理商的因果推理和任务归属为在所包含系统中进行异常检查,校正出错和断层修复提供了核心决策基础. 健全的认知只能感知到执行异常和状态偏差. 它不能区分错误的根源是来自感知噪音、规划偏差还是环境扰动。 内含的代理人能力可以结合任务指示、环境状态演变轨迹和历史相互作用经验进行全球验尸,确定出错的原因,并产生纠正策略[14、10]。 归属和推理能力越强,系统从故障样本中获得的学习效率越高,物理AI自演化迭代的上限也越高.

blocks.en: These four mechanisms form a bidirectional closed loop: agency capability drives embodied execution while physical feedback nourishes cognitive evolution, delineating a plausible path from a digital agent to a physical agent. As shown in Figure 2 , this loop is operationalized as a closed perception–reasoning–action–verification–replanning cycle that integrates agentic and embodied capabilities, re-grounding digital-world experience for physical-world perception and autonomous execution.
blocks.zh: 这四种机制组成了双向闭环:机构能力驱动包含执行,而物理反馈则会滋养认知进化,分解出一条从数字代理到物理代理的合理路径. 如图2所显示的,这一循环可操作为闭合感知-理性-行动-核查-再规划周期,将代理能力和所体现能力结合起来,重新定位数字世界经验,用于物理世界感知和自主执行。

blocks.en: 3.2  Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据校正

blocks.en: As illustrated in the Figure 3 , we construct capability-system data following the aforementioned construction paradigm for embodied agents. The dataset includes capability data for both digital and physical agents. We elaborate on the construction methodology of these capability data in the subsequent subsection.
blocks.zh: 如图3所说明的,我们按照上述建筑范式为内含物构建能力系统数据。 数据集包括数字和物理代理的能力数据。 我们在随后的分节中阐述了这些能力数据的构建方法。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Embodied Data
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 健全数据

blocks.en: Data for embodied capabilities is drawn from both open-source and self-produced sources. The open-source portion comprises four categories of capability data: embodied scene understanding, embodied task planning, and error diagnosis and recovery. In addition, we construct Recovery data based on virtual embodied environments. Specifically, action models [ 5 , 15 , 16 ] first execute designated tasks, during which offset perturbations are injected at random moments and the resulting anomalous states are saved; the model then resumes execution from each perturbed state. After validity checking, trajectories are filtered by task, perturbation parameters, and outcome, retaining at most one successful and one failed trajectory per perturbed state. The complete trajectories are then preserved per method, labeled, and converted into the training format, with state isolation between training and evaluation enforced throughout.
blocks.zh: 所体现能力的数据来自公开来源和自制来源。 开源部分包括四类能力数据:体现场景理解,体现任务规划,以及错误诊断和恢复. 此外,我们根据虚拟环境构建恢复数据。 具体来说,动作模型[5,15,16]首先执行指定的任务,在此期间会随机地注入抵消扰动并保存由此而来异常状态;然后该模型恢复从每个扰动状态执行. 经过有效性检查后,轨迹会被任务,扰动参数和结果所过滤出,每个扰动状态最多保留一个成功和一个失败的轨迹. 然后将完整的轨迹按方法保存,贴上标签,并转换为培训格式,在培训和评价之间实施国家隔离。

blocks.en: For the downstream transfer tasks, autonomous driving data comes from open-source datasets, which mainly contains four categories of capability data: panoramic scene understanding, long-tail traffic scene perception, risky object recognition, and perception-prediction-planning closed-loop decision-making. Embodied navigation data is produced by our in-house data pipeline: we build training data on two underlying navigation datasets (R2R [ 17 ] and RxR [ 18 ] scenes). The simulator collects first-person observations and atomic actions along ground-truth paths; consecutive actions in the same direction are merged into high-level actions, and the data is uniformly reorganized into a multi-turn dialogue format consistent with the evaluator. The system prompt declares a closed action space (forward 25/50/75 cm; turning 15/30/45° for R2R and 30/60/90° for RxR), each turn introduces only a single new observation frame, and the answer is a bare action list terminated by a single STOP. For each source, two decision granularities are provided: one action per turn and up to three actions per turn.
blocks.zh: 对于下游的传输任务,自主驱动数据出自开源数据集,主要包含四类能力数据:全景场景理解,长尾交通场景感知,风险对象识别,以及感知-预测-规划闭跑决策. 完善的导航数据由我们内部的数据管道产生:我们在两个基础导航数据集(R2R [17]和RxR [18]场景)上建立培训数据. 模拟器沿地真道收集第一人称观测和原子行动;同一方向的接连行动被合并为高层次行动,数据统一重组为与评价者一致的多回合对话格式. 系统提示器宣布一个闭合的动作空间(向前25/50/75厘米;转弯15/30/45°为R2R,转弯30/60/90°为RxR),每个转弯只引入了一款新的观测框架,答案是一款由一款停止结束的光线动作列表. 每个来源都提供两个决策分点:每个回合一次,最多三次。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Agent Data
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 代理数据

blocks.en: Training data for agent capabilities consists of open-source and self-produced data. The open-source portion mainly adopts tool-invocation data. In the raw data, user requests, tool schemas, function calls, tool returns, and subsequent replies are converted into a unified multi-turn trajectory format, with call parameters, turn-to-turn transitions, and observation results normalized. Data processing applies trajectory-level and turn-level filtering to remove samples with incomplete call chains, invalid parameters, tool results that are never effectively utilized, or evident redundancy. The self-produced portion consists mainly of multimodal workflow trajectories. During data production, tasks are first constructed that embed visual or environmental context, task constraints, available tools, and subtask dependencies. Multi-turn execution trajectories are then collected, preserving how the model exploits visual information, decomposes goals, organizes tool calls, and integrates intermediate results. After quality screening, the high-quality trajectories are used for distillation training, to stabilize the model’s capabilities in perception, planning, tool coordination, and long-horizon state maintenance in complex scenarios.
blocks.zh: 代理能力培训数据由开源和自制数据组成. 开源部分主要采用工具调用数据. 在原始数据中,用户请求,工具计划,函数调用,工具回放,以及后续的回放被转换为统一的多转轨迹格式,并带有调用参数,转动转换,观测结果正常化. 数据处理采用轨迹级和转弯级的过滤来去除有不完整的调用链,无效参数,从未被有效利用的工具结果或者明显的冗余. 自制部分主要由多式工作流程轨迹组成. 在数据制作过程中,任务首先构建为嵌入视觉或环境背景,任务约束,可用工具,以及子任务依赖. 然后收集多回合执行轨迹,保存模型如何利用视觉信息,分解目标,组织工具调用,并整合中间结果. 经过质量筛选后,高质量的轨迹被用于蒸馏训练,以稳定模型在感知,规划,工具协调,以及复杂情景下长视距状态维护方面的能力.

blocks.en: 4  Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 4 培训战略

blocks.en:
ME-VLM is built on a Qwen3.5-series native multimodal agent model [ 1 ] . We denote the original starting policy by π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} . Our training transfers its multimodal understanding,
planning, tool-use priors and complex reasoning into decisions grounded in physical observations and environment feedback. This transfer follows the VLA paradigm of adapting
large-scale vision-language representations to physical decision making [ 19 , 20 , 5 ] .

As illustrated in Figure 4 , realizing this transfer
requires resolving three successive optimization challenges: grounding general
semantic priors in physical states and actions, improving agentic and embodied
policies without destructive interference, and consolidating their
complementary strengths into a single deployable model. The following sections
address these challenges in this order.

blocks.en: 4.1  Embodied Capability Injection
blocks.zh: 4.1 体能注射

blocks.en:
Multimodal agent models provide useful semantic and planning priors,
but those priors do not by themselves ensure that a proposed action is
feasible for a particular embodiment or valid in the current physical state [ 21 , 22 ] . We therefore adapt the base multimodal agent through two successive SFT stages that connect pretrained semantic representations to
continuous observations, physical states, and actions.

blocks.en: 4.2  Expert Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 4.2 专家强化学习

blocks.en:
We train the two experts from different initializations. The multimodal agent
expert π θ A \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{A}}} is initialized directly from the original
base policy π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} , preserving its general multimodal
reasoning, planning, and tool-use capabilities. The embodied cognition expert π θ E \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{E}}} is initialized from π θ inj \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{inj}}} , inheriting the physical grounding and embodied
decision structure acquired through SFT. This asymmetric initialization
reflects the different optimization priorities of the two domains:
agent tasks emphasize goal decomposition, tool orchestration, and long-horizon
state tracking, whereas embodied tasks emphasize spatial accuracy, physical
feasibility, and state-transition consistency. Directly mixing heterogeneous
RL objectives can weaken domain-specific capabilities, whereas independently
trained teachers avoid unwanted coupling between the two optimization
objectives [ 24 ] . We
therefore specialize the experts first and reconcile
them only after domain-specific optimization.

blocks.en:
Environment-Loop RL trains the experts through executable multi-turn
interaction rather than isolated response evaluation. Each rollout runs in an
independent, task-specific sandbox or simulator instance initialized from a
reproducible snapshot. The initialization specifies the starting environment
state together with the task-scoped tools, Skills, resources, and software
dependencies required for execution. Rollouts sampled for the same task are
initialized from equivalent snapshots, making their outcomes comparable
within a GSPO group. After a rollout terminates, its environment is discarded
or reset, preventing side effects and state changes from leaking into other
trajectories. Executable gyms and sandboxed rollout services have become core
infrastructure for recent agent-RL systems [ 27 , 28 ] .

blocks.en:
Within each sandbox, training follows an explicit interaction loop. The model
receives the current observation and interaction history, generates a tool or
Skill call, and submits it to the environment executor. The sandbox validates
and executes the action, records its side effects, and returns the resulting
observation, execution status, or error message. This feedback is appended to
the context for the next decision, and the loop continues until the task
succeeds, reaches a failure condition, or exceeds its interaction budget.
Execution failures are retained as part of the trajectory so that the model
can learn verification, correction, and recovery rather than being trained
only on successful paths. Recent multi-turn agent-RL frameworks similarly
emphasize stochastic environment feedback, execution–training separation, and
explicit trajectory decomposition [ 29 , 30 ] .

blocks.en: Embodied tasks involving interaction with the physical world impose stringent requirements on inference latency, adaptability to complex environments, data security, and operational autonomy. Local inference on edge hardware is therefore essential for practical deployment at scale. However, deploying large embodied foundation models on edge devices introduces several system-level challenges, including limited compute capacity, power constraints, hardware architecture mismatches, and difficulties in software adaptation. These constraints create a three-way trade-off among inference accuracy, response latency, and power consumption.
blocks.zh: 涉及与实体世界互动的健全任务对推论延迟性、适应复杂环境、数据安全和业务自主性提出了严格的要求。 因此,当地对边缘硬件的推断对于大规模的实际部署至关重要。 然而,在边缘设备上部署大型被体现的地基模型,带来了几个系统层面的挑战,包括计算能力有限,动力限制,硬件架构不匹配,以及软件适应方面的困难. 这些限制在推论准确性、反应延迟性和能耗之间形成了三相取舍。

blocks.en: We address these challenges through complementary optimizations at the model and system levels. At the model level, visual token compression reduces the computational burden of the inference pipeline by compacting visual inputs before they enter the language model. At the system level, hardware–software co-design adapts the inference execution framework, sensor synchronization and scheduling mechanisms, and hardware acceleration interfaces to embodied workloads. Together, these optimizations establish an integrated execution and scheduling path spanning perception, physical reasoning, and motion planning and control. By jointly adapting algorithms and hardware, we bridge the gap between AI software developed for digital environments and embodied tasks in the physical world, enabling deployment at scale on edge devices.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在模式和系统层面进行互补优化来应对这些挑战。 在模型层面,视觉符号压缩通过在进入语言模型前将视觉输入压缩来减轻推论管道的计算负担. 在系统层面,硬件-软件共同设计将推论执行框架,传感器同步和调度机制,以及硬件加速接口相适应,以体现工作量. 这些优化共同建立了跨越感知,物理推理,运动规划和控制的综合执行和调度路径. 通过联合调整算法和硬件,我们弥合了为数字环境开发的AI软件与物理世界中包含的任务之间的差距,使得能够在边缘设备上大规模部署.

blocks.en: 5.1  Edge Acceleration Strategy
blocks.zh: 5.1 边缘加速 战略

blocks.en: The inputs to embodied policy models consist primarily of visual observations. After processing by the vision encoder and projector, individual frames, multi-view images, or videos produce a large number of visual tokens. These tokens substantially outnumber text tokens and account for most of the prefill computation on edge devices. Visual inputs in embodied scenarios also contain considerable redundancy [ 34 ] : static backgrounds across consecutive frames and overlapping regions across adjacent views cause near-duplicate features to repeatedly consume the limited token budget. We therefore introduce visual token compression to reduce the number of tokens passed to the language model while preserving the model’s capabilities.
blocks.zh: 对体现的政策模式的投入主要是视觉观察。 由视觉编码器和投影器处理后,单个帧,多视图图像,或视频产生出大量的视觉符号. 这些符号大大超过文本符号,并占了边缘设备上大多数的预填计算. 在包含的情景中,视觉投入也包含相当的冗余[34]:连续帧的静态背景和相邻观点相重叠的区域导致几乎重复的特征一再消耗有限的象征性预算. 因此,我们采用了视觉符号压缩,以减少传递给语言模型的符号数量,同时保留模型的能力.

blocks.en: For practical deployment, we adopt a training-free, plug-and-play token selection scheme. As illustrated in Figure 5 , the compression module is inserted between the visual projector and the large language model backbone, where it selects a subset of visual tokens that have already been mapped into the language model’s embedding space. The selected visual tokens are then fed into the language model together with the text tokens. The architecture and parameters of the vision encoder, projector, and language model remain unchanged. This approach requires no additional training and can be applied directly to checkpoints from any training stage. Selection only removes tokens; it neither merges tokens nor modifies their features, preserving the feature representations of the retained tokens as learned during training. The retained token count, K K , is a tunable parameter configured independently of the model according to the compute and latency budgets of the target device.
blocks.zh: 为了实际部署,我们采取了一种无培训、插座和玩牌选择方案。 如图5所示,压缩模块被插入到视觉投影机和大型语言模型主干线之间,在那里它选择了已经映射入语言模型嵌入空间的一组视觉符号. 所选取的可视符号再与文字符号一起被输入到语言模型. 视觉编码器,投影仪,和语言模型的架构和参数保持不变. 这种做法不需要额外的培训,而且可以从任何培训阶段直接适用于检查站。 选择只去除符;它既不合并符符,也不修改符的特征,保留了所保留符的特征表述作为训练期间所学. 所保留的令牌计数K K 是一个可捕获参数,按照目标设备的计算和耐用预算独立于模型配置.

blocks.en: This objective prevents near-duplicate features from dominating the token budget, allowing the retained set to cover a broad range of visual content. Since exact optimization is computationally expensive, we approximate the solution using a greedy Max-Min algorithm [ 37 ] . We initialize the retained set with the token having the largest ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm. At each subsequent iteration, we select the candidate whose maximum similarity to any token in the retained set is smallest, continuing until K K tokens have been retained. Each iteration thus prioritizes visual features that are not yet represented in the selected set, preserving diversity while removing redundancy. Once selection is complete, the retained tokens are reordered according to their original sequence indices to preserve their relative spatiotemporal structure. No token features are modified during this process.
blocks.zh: 这一目标防止了几乎重复的特征主导了象征性的预算,使得所保留的套件能够涵盖广泛的视觉内容. 由于精确优化在计算上昂贵,所以我们使用贪婪的Max-Min算法来估算解决方案[37]. 我们以最大的一 二\ell\2}规范来初始化所保留的套装。 在以后的每次迭代中,我们都会选择其与所保留的套装中任意一个令牌的最大相似度最小的候选人,持续到K令牌被保留为止. 因此,每个迭代都会优先排列尚未在所选集中被代表的视觉特性,在去除冗余的同时保留多样性. 选取完成后,所保留的令牌会按照其原有的序列指数重新排序,以保持相对的spatiopal结构. 在此过程中没有修改任何符号特性 。

blocks.en: For multi-view image or multi-stream video inputs, we apply the selection procedure independently within each stream using the same retention ratio, then organize the retained tokens according to the original input structure. This prevents the diversity objective from favoring a single view and accommodates visual inputs with varying numbers of views, resolutions, and sequence lengths.
blocks.zh: 对于多视图图像或多流视频输入,我们使用相同的保留比例在每条流内独立应用选择程序,然后按照原始输入结构来组织所保留的符号. 这使得多样性目标无法偏好单一观点,并容纳各种观点、分辨率和序列长度的视觉投入。

blocks.en: 5.2  Co-Design for M100
blocks.zh: 5.2 M100联合设计

blocks.en: We deploy the 4B model on Li Auto’s M100 system-on-chip (SoC) [ 38 ] for local inference, enabling embodied systems to operate in real-world environments without relying on remote GPU servers. The M100 SoC integrates an in-house M100 neural processing unit (NPU) designed for general-purpose AI inference, a 24-core Arm CPU subsystem, and an LPDDR5X memory subsystem supporting up to 64 GB of memory and a peak bandwidth of 273 GB/s. The Arm CPU handles application logic and inference runtime management, while the M100 NPU executes most tensor computations required by the embodied policy model. The NPU uses a compiler-orchestrated dataflow architecture, in which computation and data exchange across compute units are coordinated through software-controlled data movement between on-chip SRAM and external LPDDR5X memory. Pipelined overlap between computation and data transfers improves overall execution efficiency.
blocks.zh: 在李汽车的M100系统芯片(SoC)[38]上部署4B模型进行局部推论,使所包含系统能够在不依赖远程GPU服务器的情况下在现实环境中运行。 M100 SoC集成一个内部M100神经处理单元(NPU)为通用AI推论所设计,一个24个核心的Arm CPU子系统,以及一个LPDDR5X内存子系统,支持高达64GB的内存和273GB/s的峰值带宽. Arm CPU处理应用逻辑和推论运行时间管理,而M100 NPU则执行所包含政策模型所需要进行的大多数起角计算. NPU采用编译器-操纵数据流架构,其中计算单位之间的计算和数据交换通过由软件控制的在芯片SRAM和外部LPDDR5X内存之间的数据移动来协调. 计算和数据传输之间的管道重叠提高了总体执行效率。

blocks.en: To further reduce memory requirements and memory access overhead during edge inference, we adopt W4A8 quantization: model weights are quantized from FP16 to 4 bits, while inference activations use 8 bits. Compared with FP16 weights, 4-bit weights theoretically reduce weight storage by 75%, substantially decreasing the model’s memory footprint and the volume of data transferred when loading weights from external memory. The actual model footprint is slightly larger than this theoretical minimum because quantization scale factors and other metadata also require storage. Ablation experiments on embodied task benchmarks show less than 1% performance degradation after quantization, demonstrating that W4A8 reduces inference overhead without materially compromising model performance. Figure 6 provides an overview of the M100 deployment workflow and summarizes the effects of quantization, joint prefill optimization, and visual token compression.
blocks.zh: 为了在边缘推论中进一步减少内存要求和内存访问的间接性,我们采用W4A8量化法:模型重量从FP16到4位被量化,而推论活化则使用8位. 与FP16重量相比,4位重量理论上会将重量存储量减少75%,大大地降低了模型的内存足迹和从外部内存装入重量时传输的数据量. 实际模型脚印略大于这一理论最低标准,因为量化尺度因素和其他元数据也需要存储. 对包含的任务基准的分解实验显示,在量化后,性能退化不到1%,这表明W4A8在不实质性地损害模型性能的情况下减少了推算间接费用。 图6概述了M100部署工作流程,并总结了量化、联合预填优化和视觉符号压缩的效果。

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Joint HW-SW Optimization for Prefill
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 预填HW-SW联合优化

blocks.en: The prefill stage processes long input token sequences and accounts for a substantial share of inference latency on edge devices. Feeding the full token sequence into M100 exposes substantial computational parallelism but also incurs a large computational workload. Conversely, excessive token compression can leave too little work to fully utilize the NPU’s parallel compute capacity. We therefore jointly optimize model-level token compression and execution on M100 to identify an operating point that balances task accuracy, total computation, and hardware utilization.
blocks.zh: 预填阶段处理长输入符序列,并占边缘设备推论延迟的很大份额. 将完整的符号序列输入M100会暴露出大量的计算平行性,但也会产生大量的计算工作量. 反之,过度的符号压缩可能留下太多的工作,无法充分利用NPU的并行计算能力. 因此,我们联合优化M100的模型级符号压缩和执行,以确定一个能平衡任务准确性、总计算和硬件利用的操作点。

blocks.en: Specifically, we use W4A8 quantization together with token compression applied to the base model. Token compression reduces the number of tokens processed during prefill and subsequent computation from 4,096 to 3,328. We select this token budget based on the M100 NPU’s parallel execution capacity and profiling of real application workloads, subject to task accuracy requirements. This ensures that the resulting workload is well matched to the NPU resources allocated to the embodied model. Token compression directly reduces prefill computation, while a sufficiently large retained token budget avoids underutilization caused by excessive compression and maintains high NPU utilization for the core tensor operations. In deployment measurements, this joint optimization reduces prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms, a reduction of approximately 53% and a prefill speedup of approximately 2.13 × 2.13\times . We further evaluate the impact of visual token compression on task performance. On the evaluated tasks, the 4B and 35B models retain 96.7% and 98.2% of their respective uncompressed baseline scores after token selection. These results show that the token selection strategy reduces the visual input size while maintaining task performance close to the uncompressed baselines, supporting more efficient inference on edge devices.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们使用W4A8量化法,加上适用于基模型的符号压缩. Token压缩将预填和随后计算过程中处理的令牌从4,096个减少到3,328个. 我们根据M100 NPU的并行执行能力和真实应用工作量的概况来选择这一象征性预算,但须符合任务准确性要求。 这保证了由此产生的工作量与分配给所包含模式的核动力单位资源完全相符。 Token压缩会直接减少预填计算,而足够大的保留令牌预算则会避免过度压缩导致的利用不足,并保持高NPU对核心拉伸操作的利用. 在部署测量中,这种联合优化将预填空闲从400米减少到了188米,减少了约53%,预填空闲速度大约为2.13×2.13\时. 我们进一步评价视觉符号压缩对任务性能的影响. 在评价任务方面,4B和35B模型在象征性选择后保留了各自未压缩基准分数的96.7%和98.2%. 这些结果显示道具选择策略在保持任务性能接近未压缩基线的同时会减小视觉输入大小,支持更高效地推断边缘设备.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Compilation & Runtime Pipeline
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 汇编和运行时管道

blocks.en: The trained embodied model is compiled into an executable binary for edge deployment using the M100 compilation toolchain [ 38 ] . The compiler performs computational graph optimization, tensor tiling, and scheduling, mapping tensor operations, data transfers, and synchronization primitives onto M100 NPU resources. For key operators in the model, the compiler exploits spatial parallelism across compute blocks and opportunities for pipelined execution to improve overall hardware utilization.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的内含模型被汇编成可执行的二进制,用于利用M100汇编工具链进行边缘部署[38]. 编译器进行计算图优化,拉伸平板,以及调度,绘图拉伸操作,数据传输,并同步原始到M100 NPU资源. 对于模型中的关键操作员,编译器利用了跨计算块的空间平行性以及管道执行的机会来提高整体硬件利用率.

blocks.en: The runtime software consists of two layers: an AI inference runtime executing on the SoC’s Arm CPU cores and NPU firmware executing on the RISC-V processor within the M100 NPU. The inference runtime manages model loading, input preprocessing, inference task submission, and output postprocessing. The NPU firmware handles low-level tensor instruction dispatch, compute-unit scheduling, and data transfers between on-chip and external memory. Together, these components provide a complete on-device inference pipeline from sensor acquisition to robot policy output.
blocks.zh: 运行时软件由两层组成:在SOC的Arm CPU核心上进行AI推断运行时执行和在M100 NPU内进行RISC-V处理器上的NPU固件执行. 推断运行时间管理模型加载,输入预处理,推断任务提交,输出后处理. NPU固件处理低等收发式的收发式,计算单元调度,以及芯片和外存之间的数据传输. 这些组件共同提供了一个完整的从传感器获取到机器人政策输出的基于设备推导管.

blocks.en: 6.3.1 Autonomous Driving

blocks.en:

reasoning, and decision interpretation in complex and dynamic environments,
making it an important application domain for evaluating the coordination
between embodied cognition and agent capabilities. We adapt ME-VLM to
autonomous-driving tasks and compare it with
representative embodied models on five benchmarks: MAPLM, CODA-LM, DriveAction,
nuScenes-QA, and MME-RealWorld. As shown in
Table 3 , ME-VLM 35B-A3B achieves the highest average

blocks.en: 6.3.2 Embodied Navigation
blocks.zh: 6.3.2 健康导航

blocks.en:
Embodied navigation requires an agent to follow natural-language instructions
and perform path planning and long-horizon execution in three-dimensional
environments, placing substantial demands on spatial perception, instruction
grounding, and cross-step state tracking. We evaluate ME-VLM on the R2R
Val-Unseen and RxR Val-Unseen benchmarks against representative embodied
models, including PhysBrain 1.5, RynnBrain 1.1, MiMo-Embodied, and
Hy-Embodied. As shown in Table 4 , ME-VLM 35B-A3B
substantially outperforms all competing models across both benchmarks. On R2R
Val-Unseen, it achieves a navigation error (NE) of 5.9, an oracle success rate
(OS) of 56.3, a success rate (SR) of 45.8, and a success rate weighted by path
length (SPL) of 39.4. In comparison, the strongest baseline results are 9.2 in
NE, 15.3 in OS, 5.3 in SR, and 4.4 in SPL. On RxR Val-Unseen, ME-VLM 35B-A3B
achieves an NE of 6.8, an SR of 42.6, an SPL of 35.3, and an nDTW score of
57.9. These results considerably exceed the strongest baseline scores of 11.2
in NE, 8.3 in SR, 5.6 in SPL, and 26.3 in nDTW. The compact ME-VLM 4B model
also consistently surpasses the compared baselines, demonstrating that the
improvement is preserved across model scales. These results indicate that the
spatial reasoning, temporal state modeling, and long-horizon planning
capabilities developed during embodied post-training can be effectively adapted
to navigation, enabling strong coordination between language-instruction
understanding and path execution.

blocks.en: 7  Applications
blocks.zh: 7项申请

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Embodied-navigation cases. Instruction-following navigation with multi-action and single-action response formats.
blocks.zh: 图8:健康航行案例。 指令后导航采用多动作和单动作响应格式.

blocks.en: We further examine how the capabilities of ME-VLM generalize to representative applications spanning embodied task execution, digital tool use, and closed-loop interaction with physical environments. The following qualitative cases emphasize how the model grounds instructions in observations, organizes multi-step actions, incorporates execution feedback, and produces verifiable task outcomes.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查ME-VLM的能力如何将通用到具有代表性的应用程序,涵盖包含的任务执行、数字工具的使用以及与物理环境的闭路互动。 以下定性案例强调模型如何在观察中说明理由、组织多步骤行动、纳入执行反馈并产生可核查的任务结果。

blocks.en: 7.1  Embodied Applications
blocks.zh: 7.1 健康应用

blocks.en: 7.1.1 Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: 7.1.1 自动驾驶

blocks.en: Autonomous driving requires a model to jointly understand dynamic traffic scenes, track temporally evolving states, and relate perceived objects to driving decisions. Figure 7 presents four cases covering complementary aspects of these capabilities. ME-VLM identifies traffic cones and pedestrians ahead, tracks a green traffic signal across successive observations, and explains how the preceding vehicle, road signs, and traffic cones constrain the appropriate driving behavior. The text-only case further shows that the model can combine a navigation instruction with lane descriptions to infer that the current lane permits both through and left-turn movements. Across these cases, the generated responses remain semantically consistent with the reference answers, demonstrating reliable scene understanding and driving-oriented reasoning under diverse input formats.
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶需要一个模式,共同理解动态交通场景,跟踪时间演变状态,并将感知到的物体与驾驶决定联系起来. 图7列出了涉及这些能力互补方面的四个案例。 ME-VLM识别出前面的交通锥和行人,通过相继的观测跟踪绿色交通信号,并解释前面的车辆,路标,交通锥是如何约束适当的驾驶行为的. 仅以文字为主的案例进一步表明,该模型可以将通航指示和道道描述结合起来,推断出目前道道道既允许通过也允许左转. 在所有这些案件中,所产生的答复与参考答复保持了一致,显示了对现场的可靠理解和以不同投入格式为导向的推理。

blocks.en: 7.1.2 Embodied Navigation
blocks.zh: 7.1.2 健康导航

blocks.en: Embodied navigation requires the model to ground natural-language instructions in a sequence of visual observations while maintaining spatial and execution states over long horizons. Figure 8 shows two successful navigation cases, where each image corresponds to the observation preceding the associated response. In the hall-traversal task, ME-VLM reaches the goal in five responses, each containing three actions that combine forward motion with orientation adjustment. In the longer landmark-based task, the model passes through a doorway and reaches the target bookshelf in 21 single-action responses. The final distances to the two goals are 0.88 m and 0.75 m, respectively. These cases show that ME-VLM can support both compact multi-action prediction and step-by-step control while preserving instruction grounding and spatial consistency throughout execution.
blocks.zh: 健美的导航需要模型将自然语言指令以视觉观测的顺序进行地面定位,同时保持空间状态和执行状态超过长的地平线. 图8显示两个成功的导航案例,其中每个图像对应相关响应之前的观测. 在大厅-转弯任务中,ME-VLM在5个响应中达到了目标,每个响应包含3个动作,将前进运动和方向调整结合起来. 在较长的地标性任务中,该模型通过一个出入口,在21个单行动响应中到达了目标书架. 两个入球的最后距离分别为0.88米和0.75米. 这些案例表明,ME-VLM可以支持紧凑的多动作预测和分步控制,同时在整个执行过程中保持指令地基和空间一致性.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Order-profit analysis. ME-VLM retrieves and reconciles enterprise records, calculates profit statistics, identifies payment exceptions, and writes the final report.
blocks.zh: 图9:订单-利润分析。 ME-VLM检索和调节企业记录,计算利润统计,确定支付例外,并撰写最后报告.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Visually grounded contact retrieval. ME-VLM searches for information absent from the input image, verifies candidate contacts against the official website, and answers with supporting evidence.
blocks.zh: 图10:可视化的接触检索。 ME-VLM搜索输入图像中缺失的信息,通过官方网站验证候选人联系人,并以支持性证据进行回答.

blocks.en: 7.2  Digital Agent Applications
blocks.zh: 7.2 数字代理应用

blocks.en: The following cases examine whether ME-VLM can extend its perception and planning capabilities to multi-step tasks involving external information and digital tools. In both cases, the model must identify the information required by the user, invoke appropriate tools, incorporate intermediate results, and return a verifiable final response.
blocks.zh: 以下案例审查ME-VLM是否能够将其感知和规划能力扩展到涉及外部信息和数字工具的多步骤任务. 在这两种情况下,模型必须确定用户需要的信息,援引适当的工具,纳入中间结果并返回可核查的最后答复。

blocks.en: Figure 9 presents a business-analysis task involving multiple enterprise systems and structured records. Given a high-level request, ME-VLM retrieves customer orders from the CRM system, extracts product identifiers and selling prices, and queries inventory and finance tools for the corresponding costs and transaction records. It then reconciles the retrieved information, calculates order-level margins, identifies unpaid balances and refunds, and writes the complete analysis to a report. The case shows that ME-VLM can decompose an open-ended objective, coordinate successive tool calls, maintain intermediate task states, and consolidate execution results into a structured and verifiable output.
blocks.zh: 图9列出了涉及多个企业系统和结构化记录的业务分析任务。 鉴于一个高层次的请求,ME-VLM从客户关系管理系统取回客户订单,取出产品识别码和销售价格,并查询库存和金融工具以了解相应的成本和交易记录. 然后核对检索到的信息,计算订单级别的差值,确定未付余额和退款,并将完整的分析写成报告。 案例显示,ME-VLM可以分解一个可开放的目标,协调接连的工具调用,保持中间任务状态,并将执行结果整合为结构化和可核查的产出.

blocks.en: Figure 10 shows a case that combines image understanding with external information retrieval. Given a menu image and a request for a booking phone number, ME-VLM identifies the restaurant while recognizing that the requested contact information is absent from the image. It therefore searches for candidate contacts and retrieves the official website to verify the results before answering. The final response organizes the verified phone numbers by branch and provides the supporting source. This case demonstrates the model’s ability to recognize insufficient visual evidence, select appropriate tools, verify retrieved information, and produce an evidence-grounded response rather than relying on an unsupported inference.
blocks.zh: 图10显示一个将图像理解与外部信息检索相结合的案例. 鉴于菜单图像和预订电话号码的请求,ME-VLM识别餐厅,同时承认图像中缺少所要求的联系信息. 因此,它搜索候选人的联系人,并检索官方网站,以便在答复前核实结果。 最终反应按分支组织核实的电话号码,并提供了支持来源. 这一案例表明,该模型有能力识别视觉证据不足,选择适当的工具,核实检索到的信息并作出有证据依据的反应,而不是依赖无依据的推论。

blocks.en: 7.3  Embodied Agent Applications
blocks.zh: 7.3 健康代理应用程序

blocks.en: Beyond perception and open-loop action prediction, an embodied agent must connect natural-language objectives to executable Skills and revise its decisions according to changes in the physical state. We present simulation and real-world manipulation cases to examine spatial grounding, action sequencing, execution monitoring, and feedback-driven correction within this closed interaction loop.
blocks.zh: 除了感知和开放动作预测外,一个被体现的代理人必须将自然语言目标与可执行技能联系起来,并根据物理状态的变化修改其决定. 我们提出模拟和现实世界操纵案例,以审查空间地平面、动作测序、执行监测和在这个封闭的相互作用圈内反馈驱动的纠正。

blocks.en: 7.3.1 Simulation Environment
blocks.zh: 7.3.1 模拟环境

blocks.en: The simulation cases examine how ME-VLM translates visual and linguistic observations into manipulation actions under controlled execution feedback. The first case focuses on spatial reference resolution and single-round planning, whereas the second evaluates recovery from initial perception and execution errors.
blocks.zh: 模拟案例研究了ME-VLM如何将视觉和语言观测转化为受控执行反馈下的操纵行动. 第一个案例侧重于空间参考分辨率和单一回合规划,而第二个案例则评价从最初的认知和执行错误中恢复的情况。

blocks.en: In the left panel of Figure 11 , the model receives the instruction “Stack the cube at the back on the triangular prism on the right.” It resolves the spatial references to identify the green cube and the rightmost green triangular prism among multiple objects of the same types. ME-VLM then produces an ordered sequence of approach, grasp, lift, transfer, and release actions. The simulator confirms successful stacking after five valid actions in a single planning round, showing that the model can connect spatially grounded object recognition to an executable manipulation plan.
blocks.zh: 在图11的左面板中,该模型收到指令“将立方体放在后方右侧三角棱镜上。” 它解决了空间引用,在同类型多对象中识别出绿色立方体和最右侧绿色三角棱. 然后,ME-VLM产生一个顺序的取向、取回、起重、转移和释放动作。 模拟器确认在单一规划回合的5个有效动作后成功堆放,显示该模型可以将空间上基于对象的识别与可执行操作计划相连接.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Simulated object stacking. Left: ME-VLM resolves spatial references and completes the task with five valid actions in a single planning round. Right: ME-VLM revises its target identification and action plan using execution feedback, completing the task after three planning rounds.
blocks.zh: 图11:模拟对象堆放. 左:ME-VLM解决了空间引用,并在单一的规划回合中用五个有效的动作来完成任务. 右:ME-VLM使用执行反馈修改目标识别和行动计划,经过三轮规划后完成任务.

blocks.en: In the right panel of Figure 11 , the instruction is “Place the gray crescent-shaped object on the lime-colored object of the same shape.” The model initially confuses the lime-colored target with a green object, leading to invalid actions during execution. After receiving environment feedback and an updated visual observation, it revises the target identity and placement coordinates while accounting for the changed position of the manipulated object. The task is completed after three planning rounds. Rather than relying on a correct initial prediction, this case highlights the model’s ability to incorporate execution feedback, update its scene state, and iteratively recover from perception and action errors.
blocks.zh: 在图11的右面板中,指示是“将灰色的再生形状物体置于同形状的石灰色物体上。” 该模型最初将石灰色目标与绿色物体相混淆,导致执行过程中的动作无效. 接收环境反馈并更新了视觉观察后,它修改了目标身份和位置坐标,同时计算被被操纵对象位置的变化. 任务经过三轮规划后完成. 这个案例并不依赖于正确的初步预测,而是强调模型能够包含执行反馈,更新其场景状态,并反复从感知和动作错误中恢复.

blocks.en: 7.3.2 Real-World Environment
blocks.zh: 7.3.2 现实世界环境

blocks.en: Real-world embodied tasks additionally require the model to align user intent with changing physical observations and to determine both what actions to execute and when to execute them. The following robotic manipulation cases evaluate compound-instruction decomposition and visually triggered execution in a physical environment.
blocks.zh: 现实世界包含的任务还要求该模式使用户的意图与改变的物理观察保持一致,并确定执行哪些行动和何时执行。 以下机器人操纵案例评价了复合干扰分解和在物理环境中被视相触发的行刑.

blocks.en: In the left panel of Figure 12 , the user instructs the system to “Put the toy and blue bowl in the basket.” ME-VLM identifies the two target objects and the shared destination, then decomposes the instruction into two placement subtasks. The system places the toy first and the blue bowl second, successfully completing both operations through sequential Skill invocation. This case shows how ME-VLM converts a compound instruction into a structured execution plan while maintaining the target and destination states across multiple physical actions.
blocks.zh: 在图12左面板中,用户指示系统“把玩具和蓝碗放入篮子中”。 ME-VLM识别出两个目标对象和共享目的地,再将指令分解为两个放置子任务. 系统将玩具放在第一位和蓝碗放在第二位,通过相继的"技能引用"成功完成两个操作. 这个案例显示了ME-VLM如何将复合指令转换为结构化的执行计划,同时在多个物理动作中保持目标和目的地状态.

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Real-world robotic manipulation. Left: ME-VLM decomposes a multi-object instruction and sequentially places both targets into the basket. Right: ME-VLM monitors the environment and executes the requested placement after verifying that the specified visual condition is satisfied.
blocks.zh: 图12:现实世界机器人操纵. 左:ME-VLM分解出多对象指令并相继将两个目标放入篮子. 右: ME-VLM 监测环境,并在验证指定的视觉条件满足后执行请求的放置.

blocks.en: In the right panel of Figure 12 , the user provides the conditional instruction “When a green bowl appears, put the spoon in it.” ME-VLM interprets the appearance of the green bowl as the execution condition and monitors the scene until the event occurs. It then uses a new visual observation to verify the target and scene state before invoking the placement Skill. This case illustrates the coordination of conditional-instruction understanding, visual event monitoring, scene verification, and physical execution, enabling the model to initiate an action at the appropriate time rather than immediately after receiving the instruction.
blocks.zh: 在图12的右面板中,用户提供有条件的指令“当一个绿色碗出现时,把勺子放进去。” ME-VLM将绿色碗的外观解释为执行条件并监视场景直至事件发生. 然后,它使用新的视觉观察来验证目标和场景状态,然后再引用放置技能. 这一案例表明有条件指示的理解、目视事件监测、现场核查和实体执行的协调,使模型能够在适当的时候而不是在收到指示之后立即采取行动。

blocks.en: 8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified embodied vision-language model for physical perception, spatial reasoning, task planning, and feedback-driven execution. We constructed comprehensive embodied training data and developed a three-stage post-training pipeline comprising embodied capability injection, expert reinforcement learning, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, while incorporating general reasoning and tool-use capabilities as complementary support for long-horizon interaction and Skill orchestration. ME-VLM achieves strong performance across embodied benchmarks, and its capabilities acquired through the unified training pipeline can be directly applied to autonomous driving and embodied navigation. Experiments in simulated and real-world environments further demonstrate its ability to ground instructions in physical scenes, execute multi-step actions, respond to environmental changes, and recover from failures using execution feedback. Moreover, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware–software co-design enable local deployment of ME-VLM 4B on the M100 NPU with controlled accuracy degradation, providing a practical foundation for closed-loop embodied intelligence in real-world environments.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了MachEmbody-VLM(ME-VLM),这是一个统一的包含视觉语言模型,用于物理感知,空间推理,任务规划以及反馈驱动的执行. 我们构建了一整套综合培训数据,并开发了一个三阶段培训后管道,包括包含能力注入、专家强化学习和多教师政策提炼,同时纳入一般推理和工具使用能力,作为对长视野互动和技能协调的补充支持。 ME-VLM在所体现基准方面实现强效,其通过统一培训管道获得的能力可被直接用于自主驾驶和所体现导航。 模拟和现实世界环境中的实验进一步证明了其在物理场景中地面指示,执行多步动作,应对环境变化,并使用执行反馈从失败中恢复的能力. 此外,视觉信号压缩、W4A8量化和硬件-软件共同设计使ME-VLM 4B在M100 NPU上局部部署具有可控的精度降解,为现实世界环境中的闭路所体现智能提供了一个实际基础。
